description: Source code for the VolumeZone plugin in Kubernetes scheduler, implementing volume zone affinity filtering and prefiltering logic.

classes.name: VolumeZone
classes.description: Kubernetes scheduler plugin that filters nodes based on volume zone topology constraints.

classes.name: pvTopology
classes.description: Struct representing the topology label information of a PersistentVolume.

classes.name: stateData
classes.description: Struct holding pre-filter state data, including PV topology information for a pod.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin.

methods.name: SignPod
methods.description: Provides signing information for a pod related to volume sources.

methods.name: PreFilter
methods.description: Pre-filter phase to determine PV topology for a pod's volume claims.

methods.name: getPVbyPod
methods.description: Retrieves PV topology information for a pod's volume claims.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters nodes based on volume zone topology constraints.

methods.name: getPVTopologies
methods.description: Extracts PV topology labels from a PersistentVolume.

methods.name: EventsToRegister
methods.description: Returns cluster events that can trigger re-evaluation of pod scheduling.

methods.name: getPersistentVolumeClaimNameFromPod
methods.description: Extracts PVC names from a pod's volume specifications.

methods.name: isSchedulableAfterPersistentVolumeClaimChange
methods.description: Determines if PVC changes make a pod schedulable.

methods.name: isPVCRequestedFromPod
methods.description: Checks if a PVC is requested by a specific pod.

methods.name: isSchedulableAfterStorageClassAdded
methods.description: Checks if a new StorageClass makes a pod schedulable.

methods.name: isSchedulableAfterPersistentVolumeChange
methods.description: Checks if PV topology changes make a pod schedulable.

methods.name: getPVTopologies
methods.description: Retrieves topology labels from a PV.

methods.description: Initializes and returns a new VolumeZone plugin instance.
